editorial:
Imagine a city where people are being ripped apart by something wild, and then you meet the sweetest little grandma you have ever seen. She takes in a lonely traveler who seems harmless, but there is a huge catch. The guy is actually a werewolf responsible for all those scary attacks in LA. Things go from bad to worse when he bites her, turning the kindly old lady into a bloodthirsty monster. You get to follow her adult son, who is suddenly stuck in a nightmare trying to stop his own mother and a stranger from eating the neighborhood. It is a wild mix of silly humor and creepy monster moments that keeps you guessing.

You will really enjoy the practical effects and the way the movie balances the laughs with the scares. While the pacing slows down a bit in the middle, the chaos of the final act makes up for it. If you love old-school monster movies with a bit of a family twist, you should definitely check this one out. You can grab a 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection for the best picture quality, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up with a big showdown where the son has to face both werewolves. After a messy fight, the son manages to defeat the nomad werewolf for good. However, he realizes there is no cure for his mother. In a sad but necessary move, he has to kill her to stop her from hurting anyone else. It ends on a dark note, showing that some monsters can never go back to being human.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 90s horror and monster movies.
